description: FREE pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - the full assessability matrix row for the declared family and form plus the resolved per-factor status; no factor is computed and no hygiene finding is returned. The full signed report is the paid scope_hygiene_audit call.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

family.description: The memory-store family of the export: mem0, zep_graphiti, letta, or generic.

form.description: The export form: full_text or hash_only.

manifest.description: Optional manifest declaring scope keys / sharing markers; a declaration replaces the family default scope-key set.

records.description: The export's records (up to 1,000; body up to 262,144 bytes). Processed in memory only and never stored.

variant.description: Optional family variant (e.g. zep_cloud for Zep/Graphiti).

name: scope_hygiene_precheck
